info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Settlement Accounts Retrieval API
info.description: The Settlement Accounts Retrieval API provides access to detailed information about settlement accounts associated with a specific entity. This endpoint allows clients to retrieve data based on the provided identifier, facilitating account management and reconciliation processes. Typical consumers include financial institutions, payment processors, and accounting systems that require up-to-date account information for processing transactions and ensuring accurate records. With this API, users can efficiently access and integrate settlement account details into their systems.

get.description: This operation retrieves the details of a settlement account identified by its unique account identifier. You can use this endpoint to obtain the account information necessary for financial operations or reporting.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve operations related to a specific settlement account identified by the account number 'ACC-200045'. The response will include detailed information about the transactions associated with this account.

200.description: Successful retrieval of the settlement account details.

GetSettlementAccountsByIdRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for retrieving operations related to a specific settlement account.

GetSettlementAccountsByIdResponse_200.title: Settlement Account Response

settlementAccountId.description: The unique identifier for the settlement account.

merchantId.description: The unique identifier for the merchant associated with this account.

isDefault.description: Indicates if this is the default settlement account.

verificationStatus.description: The verification status of the settlement account.

status.description: The current status of the settlement account.

GetSettlementAccountsByIdResponse_200.description: Represents the response structure containing details about a settlement account.

branchCode.description: The branch code of the account.

numberMasked.description: The masked account number for security reasons.

settlementDelayBusinessDays.description: The number of business days to delay the settlement.

ScheduleDetails.description: Contains information about the settlement schedule.

MinimumPayoutAmount.title: Minimum Payout Amount

MinimumPayoutAmount.description: Represents the minimum payout amount required for the settlement.

bearerAuth.description: Authentication scheme utilizing JSON Web Tokens (JWT) for secure access. Clients must include the bearer token in the Authorization header of their requests.
